reason: The image shows an interior view of a steel-framed industrial shed under construction — correctly representing the primary segment (single-storey clear-span steel frame warehouse/factory shed), so the product shown is not wrong.

However, an interior under-construction shot poorly communicates the complete PEB system to a buyer; an exterior view showing the full assembled structure with roof cladding, wall panels, and clear-span profile would be significantly more impactful and informative for a B2B buyer evaluating the product.

mcat_image_suggestions.prompt_for_generation: Photorealistic exterior view of a large single-storey pre-engineered steel building (PEB) warehouse or factory shed on a clean white background. The structure features a symmetrical gable roof with grey/blue colour-coated profiled metal sheet cladding, tapered built-up I-section primary rigid frames visible at the gable end, C/Z purlin secondary members, and a wide clear-span bay with no intermediate columns. Large industrial sliding doors at the front, ventilators at the ridge, and natural daylight. Steel painted in standard industrial blue-grey. Sharp product-photography lighting, slight three-quarter perspective angle to show both the front facade and side elevation, no people, no clutter, photorealistic quality.
